# FOod additive


Food additives are the chemicals or the substances added to the food products in order to keep them
fresh and to provide enhancement to their texture and flavour. They are added only to the food items
that are not included in the GRAS (generally recognized as Safe) list. This GRAS list includes the
names of only those items which have been in use for long and have not shown any adverse signs. Food
items like salt, sugar and flour have been included in this list. Sellers also need prior Government
approval for adding Food additives in their products.

Food additives include flavour enhancers, preservatives and a variety of food colouring products
like cochineal. They are safe, as only the additives which are found to be safe and having no
adverse effect are approved by the Government. In most cases, food additives mentioned on the label
are included in the other ingredients section. While sometimes their names are clearly mentioned
while at number of times they are also mentioned with their codes. It is important to add food
additives, to some food items so as to maintain the safety of the product through its journey from
factories to warehouse and throughout the process of its transportation to finally making it
available to the end users.

# FOod additive


Food additives are the chemicals or the substances added to the food products in order to keep them
fresh and to provide enhancement to their texture and flavour. They are added only to the food items
that are not included in the GRAS (generally recognized as Safe) list. This GRAS list includes the
names of only those items which have been in use for long and have not shown any adverse signs. Food
items like salt, sugar and flour have been included in this list. Sellers also need prior Government
approval for adding Food additives in their products.

Food additives include flavour enhancers, preservatives and a variety of food colouring products
like cochineal. They are safe, as only the additives which are found to be safe and having no
adverse effect are approved by the Government. In most cases, food additives mentioned on the label
are included in the other ingredients section. While sometimes their names are clearly mentioned
while at number of times they are also mentioned with their codes. It is important to add food
additives, to some food items so as to maintain the safety of the product through its journey from
factories to warehouse and throughout the process of its transportation to finally making it
available to the end users.

### About Us

## Capturing Nature’s Chemistry in the goodness of our ingredients.

GM Botanicals is one of the world’s leading botanical extract suppliers, offering a comprehensive
portfolio of premium products. These include essential oils, herbal extracts, organic herbs and
spices, organic products, food ingredients, personal care extracts, and probiotics and enzymes.

We take pride in being a part of **[Global Merchant’s][19]** rich legacy. Global merchants are known
for their valuable contributions as leading exporters and manufacturers of botanical extracts and
organic ingredients. Sourced sustainably and processed with a focus on bioavailability reflects our
commitment to deliver quality.

Our two strategically placed warehouses on the west and east coasts of the USA command a strong
global presence. We also have a well-established global footprint across the US and Canada,
including offices in Toronto, Vancouver, and Los Angeles.

We translate the secrets of nature’s resources into easy-to-use formats to enrich your formulations.
Our certifications and international standard compliances underscore our promise of excellence.

GM Botanicals takes pride in being a well-trusted, vetted supplier of a range of organic extracts,
essential oils, herbal extracts, and more.

### About Us

## Capturing Nature’s Chemistry in the goodness of our ingredients.

GM Botanicals is one of the world’s leading botanical extract suppliers, offering a comprehensive
portfolio of premium products. These include essential oils, herbal extracts, organic herbs and
spices, organic products, food ingredients, personal care extracts, and probiotics and enzymes.

We take pride in being a part of **[Global Merchant’s][19]** rich legacy. Global merchants are known
for their valuable contributions as leading exporters and manufacturers of botanical extracts and
organic ingredients. Sourced sustainably and processed with a focus on bioavailability reflects our
commitment to deliver quality.

Our two strategically placed warehouses on the west and east coasts of the USA command a strong
global presence. We also have a well-established global footprint across the US and Canada,
including offices in Toronto, Vancouver, and Los Angeles.

We translate the secrets of nature’s resources into easy-to-use formats to enrich your formulations.
Our certifications and international standard compliances underscore our promise of excellence.

GM Botanicals takes pride in being a well-trusted, vetted supplier of a range of organic extracts,
essential oils, herbal extracts, and more.

## Healing Fragrances Aromatherapy School

Founded in 2002 by Danielle Sade, our mission is to provide the latest education on aromatherapy and
essential oils. Our students will gain a deep understanding of essential oils and an unbiased
education that eliminates misinformation. Our courses can be taken at your own pace, from anywhere
in the world. You will have unlimited access to the learning platform and one-on-one support. 

Upon graduating, you will have the knowledge to succeed at each stage of your aromatherapy journey.
Our graduates have used their knowledge and skills as a solitary vocation in clinical care, skincare
cosmetics, formulators, or have effectively integrated aromatherapy into their careers. Once you
have graduated you will become a Certified Aromatherapy Health Professional (CAHP), recognized by
the Canadian Federation of Aromatherapist. Whether you are looking to invest in your interests or
enhance your career, our courses are designed to take your knowledge to the next level.

our bakery, and stock up on every household and kitchen essential in our shop. Our community is the
heartbeat of Organico so we host lots of events each month, covering a range of topics and

## What makes us stand out of the crowd?
* ### Consistency
  
  All of our products are created using the same extraction process in the same facility, which
  creates consistency. This ensures that you will receive a product that’s always reliable and
  effective.
* ### Premium Grade
  
  Our products are considered premium grade because they are manufactured using the highest
  standards. We only  offer products of the highest purity with no binders, fillers, excipients,
  dyes or unknown substances.
* ### Every Batch is Tested
  
  Our standards are rigorous and thorough. We test every single batch of our herbs and oils  through
  a third-party lab to ensure that the products you receive are the highest quality available,
  without pesticides or heavy metals.
* ### Customer Support
  
  We stand behind our products and reputation with something more than professional pride — this
  company is truly a labor of love, and it shows in every moment of your shopping experience. We
  always provide world-class customer support.
* ### Low MOQ
  
  We know that every big company had a small beginning. Hence, We offer even smaller quantities and
  Low Minimum Order Quantity requirement.
* ### Co-Packing & Contract Manufacturing
  
  Contract manufacturing, Co-packing and private labeling is available. Please ask us about this
  option.

### **Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)**

#### **Is spearmint oil safe for the skin?  **

Yes, spearmint oil can be applied to the skin when properly diluted with a carrier oil. It may help
reduce skin irritation, itching, and acne due to its cooling effect.

#### **Can spearmint oil help with digestion?**

Spearmint oil is known to support digestion and relieve nausea, bloating, and stomach discomfort. It
is often used in herbal remedies and teas.

#### **How is spearmint oil different from peppermint oil?**

While both belong to the mint family, spearmint oil has a milder aroma and lower menthol content
than peppermint oil, making it gentler and suitable for children.

#### **Do you supply spearmint oil in bulk?**

Yes, we are leading manufacturers and suppliers of pure spearmint oil in bulk and wholesale
quantities for industries like pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, and food.

Ensuring Your Safety with Every Product

 

At our core, we are dedicated to making sure that the products you use every day are not only
effective but also safe. Our team of expert Safety Assessors works tirelessly behind the scenes to
evaluate, monitor, and guarantee that every consumer product meets the highest safety standards.


How safety assessor can help

By leveraging their expertise, safety assessors help cosmetic companies develop safe, effective, and
compliant products, thus protecting consumer health and ensuring regulatory adherence.


Expertise and Qualifications

Specialized Knowledge: Safety assessors have specialised knowledge in toxicology, dermatology,
pharmacology, or a related field, enabling them to understand the complexities of chemical safety
and human health.

Regulatory Understanding: They are well-versed in relevant regulations and guidelines, such as the
EU’s Cosmetic Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009, FDA regulations, and other international standards.

 

Comprehensive Safety Evaluation

Ingredient Assessment: Assess each ingredient’s safety profile, including potential toxicity,
irritation, sensitization, and other health effects.

Exposure Calculation: Calculate the systemic exposure dosage (SED) for each ingredient based on
product use patterns, ensuring the levels are safe for intended use.

 

Risk Assessment

Hazard Identification: Identify potential hazards associated with the ingredients and the final
product.

Risk Characterization: Evaluate the risk by considering the toxicological data and the exposure
assessment, ensuring that the product poses no significant risk to consumers.

 

Margin of Safety (MoS)

Safety Margins: Calculate the margin of safety for each ingredient and the overall product, ensuring
that it meets or exceeds regulatory safety standards.

Uncertainty Factors: Apply appropriate uncertainty factors to account for variations in human
sensitivity and data gaps.

 

Stability and Microbiological Quality

Stability Testing: Review or conduct stability tests to ensure the product remains safe and
effective throughout its shelf life.


Microbiological Testing: Ensure the product is free from harmful microorganisms and that
preservatives are effective.


Documentation and Reporting
Safety Report Preparation: Compile the Cosmetic Product Safety Report (CPSR), documenting all
findings, assessments, and conclusions regarding the product’s safety.
Regulatory Compliance: Ensure that the CPSR meets all regulatory requirements and is ready for
submission to regulatory authorities if necessary.


Labelling and Instructions
Warnings and Instructions: Determine if any specific warnings or usage instructions are needed based
on the safety assessment and ensure they are clearly stated on the product label.
Compliance with Labelling Laws: Verify that the product label complies with all relevant labelling
regulations, including ingredient lists, claims, and safety warnings.

 

Continuous Monitoring
Post-Market Surveillance: Monitor adverse effects and consumer feedback once the product is on the
market, updating the safety assessment as necessary.
Regulatory Updates: Stay informed about changes in regulations and scientific advancements that
might impact product safety and compliance.


Consultation and Advice
Product Development Guidance: Provide guidance during the product development phase to ensure that
safety considerations are integrated from the beginning.
Regulatory Strategy: Advise on the best regulatory strategy for market entry, including necessary
testing and documentation.


Training and Education
Team Training: Educate and train company staff on safety and regulatory requirements, ensuring that
everyone involved in product development understands the importance of safety compliance.
Consumer Education: Provide information to consumers on safe product use, contributing to overall
public health.
